en: Added `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY` to tag OpenTelemetry metrics and events with `vcs.*` repository attributes; commit events get `vcs.ref.head.*` with `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`
zh: 新增 `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY`，用于为 OpenTelemetry 指标和事件添加 `vcs.*` 仓库属性；配合 `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS` 时，提交事件会带上 `vcs.ref.head.*`
